learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of learning mechanisms specific to neural networks (optimizers, regularization, hyperparameters).
Build neural networks capable of learning to solve classification and regression problems.
Choose the appropriate neural network architecture and loss function in each case, depending on the problem addressed.
Know the most common activation functions and understand their impact on the learning process.
Understand the operation of convolutional networks and recurrent networks, as well as their applications.
Solve learning tasks using deep neural networks.

syllabus_topics: Modeling nonlinear relationships. Nonlinear activation functions
Architectures and applications of deep neural networks
Applications: computer vision, natural language processing, etc.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, the final grade is calculated as (0.05 x S) + (0.10 x AO) + 0.45 x ((0.30 x EP1) + (0.70 x EP2)) + (0.40 x ET). It is mandatory to obtain a minimum of 4 out of 10 points in the practice block (EP) and in the theory exam (ET). If these minimums are not reached, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated formula and 4. In the extraordinary assessment, students can re-evaluate the failed theoretical and/or practical parts, with each part weighted 50%. A minimum of 4 out of 10 points is required for both the theoretical and practical parts to pass.
